variant_decisions.evidence: Qere הָאָ֑רֶץ (with article) against ketiv ארץ. ASV renders 'from the ends of the earth', a construct chain whose English definiteness follows the phrase rather than the written article: 'ends of earth' and 'ends of the earth' are indistinguishable in translation. The single note here is classed alternative_rendering and concerns the clause 'at the sound of his giving an abundance of waters', not this lemma, so it cannot decide the unit. Nothing in the English wording, no italicized supply, and no mapped textual note distinguishes the readings; the qere base fallback carries the projection.
